hobbywing_xrotor_40a_6s.source_note: HOBBYWING official: 40A continuous / 60A peak, 2-6S LiPo, no BEC. Individual ESC for multicopters (550/650 class quads). source_url normalized to the www. mirror (a.hobbywing.com fails TLS validation). Page states size "50.0x21.6x12.0mm" and weight "15g" for part_number 30901001 (International Version B, no output wires) — verbatim print order mapped to length/width/height. Version A (part 30901013, with output wires) is 42.0x21.6x12.0mm / 18.5g — NOT seeded, different part_number. Catalog hygiene (ESC XRotor variant coherence IC): mass_g corrected from a prior 26g to the page's own stated 15g for this exact PN — 26 matched neither this variant (15g) nor Version A (18.5g), was not an average or unit-conversion artifact of either, and no cited primary source was ever found for it; its origin is undocumented/unknown.
